decisions.rationale: The first undertaking after the displaced motivation sentence owns undertaking in the topic introduction. Do not map opening KUN SLONG/motivation or BSAD PAR DOD PA/wish to kill onto unrelated current English.

The complete agent noun denotes the undertaker and is rendered by the explicit relative noun phrase. Its glossary contains only deed, which is insufficient and misleading for the agent distinction; this is a contextual grammatical proposal from the complete source and English, not literal HGM attestation of the full phrase.
RANG directly attests yourself, the self-performing alternative. The explicit English you is not a second source reflexive.
The full BYAS PA directly attests perform. Its bound alternative suffix remains outside rather than being split into an arbitrary source syllable.

GZHAN means another/other in the complete reference and identifies another actor, rendered someone else. Its mined HGM a bodhisattva is unrelated to this case and is not an attested equivalent for the proposal.
BYED directly attests do in causing another person to act. It for you is English support around this verb and is not additional source morphology.
The complete DU marks the action complement of the causative get, rendered to before do. No final-s or interior English word is split.

JUG PA directly has get and functions causatively with BYED DU in this sentence. English order fronts get before the other actor; the explicit eng_order retains that crossing without expanding the verb over someone else.

DRA directly attests same, the equivalence of personal action and commissioning another. Does not matter whether and it is all the are the English framing/restatement of that equivalence; no duplicate predicate is forced.
This separate SBYOR BA owns undertaking in the essence clause, not the earlier topic occurrence.
The complete NGO BO directly attests essence and identifies the nature of the undertaking.
This topic-predication particle is realized by is in the definition of the essence. When is supplied temporal framing for the initiated deed.
MTSHON directly attests weapon in the list of methods. Some kind of is English indefinite/classifying support, not part of this head.
NAM directly attests or and joins weapon to poison; it does not own the earlier whether governing the two actors.
This independent DUG is literal poison as a method, distinct from370 three mental poisons.
GAM directly attests or and joins poison to spell, with a separate English occurrence.
The complete RIG SNGAGS directly attests spell. Its reference magical formula supports this sense without breaking it into unsupported members.
The complete means idiom directly has with and is rendered before the weapon/poison/spell list. KYI links the list to this idiom; no separate gate or through-the-gateway noun is invented.

The complete undertaking-performed construction is rendered deed is initiated. SBYOR BA directly includes initiated and BYAS PA includes deed/performing, but assigning these mechanically as reversed atoms would obscure the single construction; retain its complete local phrase without the leading article.

decisions.rationale: The complete enumerative/indefinite construction extends the preceding methods and is rendered or whatever the case may be. LA SOGS PA has or whatever and GANG YANG RUNG BA indefinite any/whether material, but the shared English whatever is not duplicated across those components.

No GNYIS/two is assigned the unrelated either introducing three methods, and no invented null is used for the frames.
